record_contract.forms: Representative visible forms or concise system labels for the comparison loop. These make grammatical gender visible where useful but never define gender count by article count.
record_contract.system_type: Lesson-specific classification such as no_grammatical_noun_gender, two_gender, three_gender, or noun_class_system. Missing data must never be interpreted as no gender.
record_contract.gender_count: Count of grammatical noun genders only where that description is appropriate. Use null for systems better represented as broader noun classes.
record_contract.own_grammar_blurb: Optional learner-facing explanation written in the language itself. Display only for a real profile language, not for an injected reference anchor.
record_contract.comparison_blurb: English research/explanation fallback for this initial English-authored lesson. It is candidate copy, not globally localized teaching text.
record_contract.review_state: Research/editorial workflow state. Candidate records may never self-promote.
record_contract.trust_state: Product confidence stage using the canonical Gef ladder: machine_translated, machine_verified, public, gef_certified.

selection_policy: Only render languages with explicit records. Do not infer gender system from language family, script, article count, or missing data.
